items.meaning: Tickets for reserved seating sell through the box office, the website and authorised resellers from a single seat map.
items.row: The system shall allow the sale of tickets for reserved seating performances through the box office, the website and authorised resellers, with a single seat map.

items.meaning: A seat is held for at most 10 minutes during an online purchase.
items.row: The system shall hold a seat for a maximum of 10 minutes during an online purchase.

items.meaning: Discounts (students, pensioners, groups of 15 or more, staff) need proof at the box office; discounted online tickets are validated at the entrance.
items.row: The system shall apply the discount schedule (students, pensioners, groups of 15 or more, staff) upon presentation of the relevant proof at the box office; online purchases of discounted tickets shall be validated at the entrance.

items.meaning: Season subscriptions of 6 performances with a fixed seat.
items.row: The system shall support season subscriptions of 6 performances with a fixed seat.

items.meaning: Never sell more than the declared hall capacity: 486 seats and 4 wheelchair spaces.
items.row: The system shall not permit the sale of more tickets than the hall capacity as declared to the fire authority (486 seats, 4 wheelchair spaces).

items.meaning: Tickets scan at the entrance from paper or a phone screen and are accepted once.
items.row: Tickets shall be scanned at the entrance from paper or a phone screen; a ticket shall be accepted once.

items.meaning: Entrance scanners work without internet for the whole performance.
items.row: The system shall operate the entrance scanners without an internet connection for the duration of a performance.

items.meaning: A settlement report per performance within 30 minutes of its end, by channel and price category.
items.row: A settlement report per performance shall be available within 30 minutes of the end of the performance, showing sales by channel and by price category.

items.meaning: Author royalties per performance as a percentage of net sales, the percentage set per production.
items.row: Author royalties shall be computed per performance as a percentage of net sales, with the percentage set per production.

items.meaning: Daily sales export to the accounting system in the Annex C format.
items.row: The system shall export daily sales to the accounting system in the format annexed (Annex C).

items.meaning: Patrons may create an account for purchase history and the programme by email; no account is required to buy.
items.row: Patrons may create an account to see their purchase history and receive the programme by email; an account shall not be required to buy a ticket.

items.meaning: All purchases require a patron account so marketing can contact the audience.
items.row: All ticket purchases shall require a patron account so that the marketing department can contact the audience.

items.meaning: The website conforms to WCAG 2.1 AA; wheelchair spaces are bookable online with an adjacent companion seat.
items.row: The website shall conform to WCAG 2.1 level AA; wheelchair spaces shall be bookable online with a companion seat adjacent.

must_not_invent: a resolution of the account contradiction (the model flags it, it does not pick a side)
a seat map for standing performances
notes: 3.4.1 and 3.4.2 contradict each other. Both are expected as items, both flagged ambiguous, and the ambiguity flag should name the contradiction. Dropping one of them, or rewriting one to agree with the other, is a failure. "Shall" wording becomes plain sentences in the reader version without losing the numbers.
